description: This file defines the custom exception class `GatewayPlaceholderReferenceUnknownFieldException`, which represents an error scenario where a referenced entity contains an unknown field placeholder. It includes methods for constructing instances based on unknown field information and JSON deserialization, along with an inner builder class.

classes.name: GatewayPlaceholderReferenceUnknownFieldException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception when a referenced entity contains an unknown field placeholder. It extends `DittoRuntimeException` and implements `GatewayException`. It provides static methods for creating instances from JSON and unknown field data, and encapsulates error information related to unknown fields.

methods.name: fromUnknownFieldAndEntityId
methods.description: Creates a builder for an exception indicating an unknown field was referenced in an entity with a specific ID, formatting message and description accordingly.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an instance of the exception from a JSON object and headers, parsing the error message embedded in JSON.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Overrides method to set headers on an existing exception instance, returning a new modified exception.
